project.name: agent-eval-contract
project.identity: A repository-local contract and fixture surface for evaluating agent behavior against Quality Runner remediation expectations.
project.audience: Maintainers and evaluators who need repeatable, artifact-backed checks for agent-facing repository contracts.
project.core_loop: Define an evaluation contract, run representative cases, compare observed artifacts with the contract, and record the remaining remediation gaps.
project.north_star: A maintainer can tell from a reproducible evaluation artifact whether an agent behavior satisfies the intended repository contract.
not_this: A replacement for the evaluated repository's own tests or Quality Runner evidence
Proof of runtime behavior from documentation alone

mvp.definition: The contract, fixtures, and expected evidence shape are explicit enough to support a focused local evaluation.

complete_product.definition: Representative evaluations run repeatably, compare actual artifacts with the contract, and preserve actionable failure evidence across repository revisions.

outcomes.name: An evaluator can identify the required inputs, outputs, and acceptance boundaries from the repository contract.

layers.intended: The project is intended to make agent-evaluation expectations explicit and inspectable.
layers.planned: The planning material calls for contract-level remediation and focused checks.
layers.implemented: Repository documentation and contract-oriented files establish the expected evaluation surface.
layers.verified: No fresh end-to-end evaluation receipt has been recorded in this bootstrap contract.

blockers.summary: A current focused evaluation run and artifact comparison are not yet recorded.
